title: AgentX recipe serving.json (schema 4)
description: Written by the recipe module to recipes/<family>/<target-id>/<framework>/serving.<model-id>.json and reviewed in a PR. model, target, framework, weights and hardware come from agentx.yaml, and every point's client_env.FRAMEWORK must equal that framework; plan pins the framework's CI image from stack.json (sglang_image for sglang, vllm_image for vllm) as image.run; client and trace are fixed in $defs below and updated by maintainers; plan adds them, arms, advisory env, devices, per-point trace, hashes and the sealed selection. None of those fields may appear here.

client.description: InferenceX checkout providing the AgentX client and trace loaders (inferencex-e2e), shared by every recipe. Maintainers bump it; plan copies it into every run.

trace.description: Agent trace dataset replayed at every point of every recipe. Maintainers bump it; plan copies it into each point and sets client_env.WEKA_LOADER_OVERRIDE to loader.

source.description: Where the recipe came from: kind and the one locator agentx.yaml recipe_source names, which must match it (config_key for inferencex, url for cookbook).

points.description: Only the points on the upstream measured Pareto frontier; plan runs all of them. ARM:CONC ids must be unique.

arm.description: Serving scheme name; plan groups points by it and names each point's result directory <model>-<arm>-c<conc> (exp_name).

gpus.description: Must not exceed the target's hardware.gpu_count; plan sets HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES from it.

launch.description: Exact server command and environment; ${AGENTX_MODEL_PATH} and ${AGENTX_PORT} are filled at run time.

client_env.description: Environment of the InferenceX AgentX client. Its parallelism sets the client's num_gpus and so throughput per GPU: TP x PP_SIZE x PCP_SIZE must equal gpus. CONC must equal the point's conc; AIPERF_EXPERIMENTAL_FAST must be 0, since fast mode replaces DURATION.
